items.title: Angle grind cop
items.description: On December 12, 2011, five people in Bellingham succeeded in slowing trains to a halt by U-locking themselves together by their necks. The police came and attempted to cut the locks off their necks with an angle grinder, and were largely unsuccessful. The photo shows the movement of the officer trying to cut a u-lock, while one of the protesters lies still.
